'''Vonn''' was the [[Premier]] of a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]-allied [[Planet/Legends|planet]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He was one of several heads of state summoned by the Imperial [[General/Legends|General]] [[Arkos Rakton]] to a diplomatic summit on [[Outpost 256]], where Rakton seized the heads of state by force. Vonn and [[Archduke/Legends|Archduke]] [[Kailur]] almost accepted Rakton's offer to join the Empire when the captives were liberated from Rakton's forces by [[Havoc Squad]]. Afterwards, those that remained loyal to the Republic called for execution of the traitors, but Havoc Squad [[Major/Legends|Major]] refused to carry it out.
